content: {"phoneNote":"Phone reads well with a strong, trade-specific hero photo; the main weakness is a wordy, vertically long page where the price grid breaks into an uneven 2+1 layout.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works, but the footer wordmark is grotesquely oversized and the hours section leaves the right half of the screen empty.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Shrink the footer wordmark on desktop to a normal heading size; it currently swallows the screen and looks like a rendering error.","Fill the empty right half of the 'Delovni čas' section on desktop (map, address or photo) and tighten the 'Kako poteka obnova' band so there are no dead areas.","Put the three prices in one row on phone (or stack all three) and reduce the oversized price numerals on desktop to keep rhythm consistent."],"blockers":["Desktop footer: the 'Tapetništvo Lesjak' wordmark is rendered at an absurd size, dominating the viewport and looking broken."]}
